description: The cached fraud analysis for a place: verdict (looks_legit / not_sure / past_manipulation / inflated / manipulated) with its label and a one-sentence summary, letter grade, 0-100 trust score, the adjusted rating credible reviewers actually give (vs the headline average), reviewer-mix tiers, review-injection statistics, cross-business duplicate-review evidence, red flags, and provenance. Cache only: on a miss, collect and submit the reviews (see check_place).

place_id.description: Google's feature id for the place (0x…:0x…, the '!1s' segment of a /maps/place URL).

url.description: Alternative to place_id: a Google Maps place link (long /maps/place/… URL or ?cid= link). Share short-links cannot be resolved; open them first.

name: get_place_trust
title: Trust analysis of a place's reviews (cached)
